title: VIXEN FetchContent caches need generator-specific sub-build directories
body: The fresh Ninja configure was run after a fresh Unix Makefiles configure using the same VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE. Exact failed command: bash tools/with-test-lock.sh --agent vixmake --resource build --label vixmake:ninja-configure -- env VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/vixmake/.tmp/fetch nice -n 10 cmake -S VIXEN -B .tmp/vixmake-ninja -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json. CMake exited 1 because the shared glm FetchContent sub-build was configured for Unix Makefiles. Workaround that succeeded: repeat the same configure with VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/vixmake/.tmp/fetch-ninja. Keep dependency sources reusable while isolating generated FetchContent sub-builds by generator, or default each build tree to its own cache base.

title: Standalone VIXEN configure needs a manual Undertow schema catalogue path
body: Both fresh standalone generator configures in this isolated VIXEN worktree needed -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json so the AppFlow and ViewNounId checks remained enabled; the relative probes cannot find Undertow's catalogue from this worktree. This requirement is documented in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt and was already observed in vixpin, but repeated here because it was necessary for this lane's 22-check witness. Consolidate catalogue discovery from the workspace or expose the path in a shared preset.

title: Direct CodegenTool dotnet run needs a supported custom output path
body: To run the pinned CodegenTool project without putting bin/obj output in the shared kernel snapshot, I tried dotnet run --project <pinned CodegenTool.csproj> -c Release --artifacts-path .tmp/vixmake-dotnet-artifacts -- <OctreeConfig --check args>. It exited 1 after build because dotnet run tried to launch the absent default bin/Release/net8.0/CodegenTool apphost. The same restore/build/check passed when I removed --artifacts-path and used the authorized pinned snapshot's default bin/obj path. Provide a direct-run recipe or wrapper that launches from the actual artifacts path.
